tone.voice: a sharp financial advisor who respects your intelligence — direct, no fluff
tone.avoid: casual, playful, vague, alarmist, overly complex jargon

ux_norms: data density is acceptable — users expect detail
numbers and amounts are always prominent and clear
charts and graphs are primary UI elements
security confirmation on all sensitive actions
dark mode is common and expected
biometric and PIN auth on every session
clear action confirmation dialogs — no accidental transfers

visual_language.style: pure interface — no photography, no illustration on core screens
photography_rules: marketing/onboarding only may use abstract lifestyle photography
never use money or cash imagery — feels untrustworthy
visual_language.background_treatment: deep dark navy or pure black for premium — clean white for light mode
visual_language.empty_state_style: minimal line icon — chart, wallet, or shield — with concise copy
visual_language.onboarding_visual: geometric abstract SVG — clean, precise, no characters
visual_language.illustration_style: when used: geometric abstract only — never cartoon or friendly characters

compliance_notes: clear terms and risk warnings required
